mistakes.label: Examined before introducing self
mistakes.message: Introduce yourself (name and role) before you examine the patient.

mistakes.label: Examined without asking permission
mistakes.message: Ask the patient's permission before you examine them.

mistakes.label: Attempted an excluded exam
mistakes.message: The door instructions exclude that exam. Describe it to the examiner instead if it matters.

mistakes.label: Knee or ankle jerk with the legs not hanging
mistakes.message: Knee and ankle jerks are easiest to see with the legs hanging over the edge of the table.

mistakes.label: Left without closing the encounter
mistakes.message: You left without closing: summarise, invite questions and say goodbye.
